audits.numeric_policy: All selected values are exact 2024 Air annual-mass rows in secondary reproductions explicitly attributed to Environment Agency Pollution Inventory 2024 under OGL. Direct EA PI/PRTR facility raw rows were not read, so confidence is capped at 98.
audits.identity_policy: Each facility is independently cross-checked against official Environment Agency permit/register material and the named operator against Companies House.
audits.method_policy: Measured/Calculated/Estimated labels are retained exactly as source reporting methods and do not create project-level measured/business promotion.
audits.component_policy: Renewable-source CO2 is a subset/component and is never added to total CO2.
audits.route_policy: Only explicit Air rows are selected; wastewater and absent values are fail-closed.
audits.zero_policy: Zero-looking, blank or unavailable values are never inferred as zero or promoted.
audits.duplicate_policy: Fresh repository searches across all six selected permit/value groups returned zero existing promoted matches.
audits.timestamp_integrity: Some earlier child-branch generated_at values were observed to be ahead of the current trusted runtime clock. Part85 uses the current trusted runtime clock; earlier child generated_at values are non-authoritative for ordering, and Git commit parent order is authoritative until explicitly corrected.

quality.confidence_policy: 98 maximum until a direct Environment Agency PI or Defra UK PRTR raw row is read and matched to facility, year, medium, pollutant, value and method.
